NAME COLLISION: The extracted code does not match the stub'\''s PURPOSE (e.g., dashboard UI code proposed for a Python memory database).\\\n2. SYNTAX BREAKAGE: Mixing languages (e.g., JavaScript inside a .py file) without proper string-wrapping.\\\n\\\n[OUTPUT FORMAT]\\\nRespond with PURE JSON ONLY.
